category_notes.first_vs_latent: Recorded feedback is the actual first failure. Independent additional failed predicates are latent diagnostics, never extra recorded tool calls.
category_notes.combined_guard: Road-null and global unbounded-unknown are separate field components of one historical UNBOUNDED_UNKNOWN guard, not two historical failures.
category_notes.nulls: Null instantaneous position or velocity alone does not reject T1. Null occupancy and uncertainty have separate hard guards.
category_notes.bounds: A whole_interval_envelope label, finite polygon and self-reported uncertainty do not establish calibrated probability or empirical coverage.
category_notes.relevance: All declared objects are universally required by T1; no candidate corridor or geometric irrelevance proof is computed here.
category_notes.free_text: confidence_note is preserved verbatim but never parsed by T1. Missing-vs-unbounded and scenario premises are not typed per object.
category_notes.causality: No T3 code is run or used to explain these historical T1 failures. No artificial examples enter any online numerator or denominator.
